snippet.title: PRE-ECHO | Announcement Trailer | Co-op Horror Mystery
snippet.description:
August 1994. In the small town of Greyford, an old radio picks up events before they happen. Explore by day, change the outcome by night, and uncover the truth alone or with up to three friends.

Wishlist PRE-ECHO on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5367450/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=f1_anuncio&utm_content=mkt0024

• Co-op horror mystery, 1–4 players, also solo
• English and Spanish (Spain) from day one
• Free demo coming in early 2027
• Press kit: https://preechogame.com/presskit/
• Website: https://preechogame.com
• Contact: press@preechogame.com

Made in Spain by an independent developer.
#PREECHO #horrorgames #indiegame #coophorror
